evals.prompt: I recorded a podcast episode where I walk through how I built my own self-hosted RSS reader. I'm going to upload it to YouTube and I want the full SEO package. The transcript is in the attached file with timestamps.
evals.expected_output: A structured markdown SEO document saved as a .seo.md file with three title options, a copy-paste description with chapter timestamps derived from the transcript's real timecodes, comma-separated tags, a pinned comment, and thumbnail suggestions.
expectations: Output is a markdown document saved to a .seo.md file
Document has a Titles section with exactly three title options
Each title is under 70 characters
Document has a Description section containing chapter timestamps
First chapter timestamp is 0:00
At least one chapter timestamp matches a timecode present in the source transcript
Document has a Tags section with comma-separated tags
Total tag characters stay under 500
Document has a Pinned Comment section that invites a reply
Document has a Thumbnail Suggestions section with two or more suggestions

evals.prompt: Here's the transcript from a video I just recorded about setting up a home recording studio for podcasting. I'd like you to create the SEO for uploading it to YouTube. I don't have timestamps in the transcript.
evals.expected_output: A structured markdown SEO document saved as a .seo.md file with three title options, a description with chapter timestamps estimated from the transcript's topic shifts and clearly flagged as approximate, comma-separated tags, a pinned comment, and thumbnail suggestions.
expectations: Output is a markdown document saved to a .seo.md file
Document has a Titles section with exactly three title options
Document has a Description section containing chapter timestamps
First chapter timestamp is 0:00
Chapter timestamps are marked as estimates or approximations
Document flags that the timestamps need verification before publishing
Document has a Tags section with comma-separated tags under 500 characters
Document has a Pinned Comment section that invites a reply
Document has a Thumbnail Suggestions section with two or more suggestions
Document has at least three chapters in the description

evals.prompt: I run a YouTube channel about home gardening for total beginners, and I want this next video to rank for the phrase 'beginner vegetable garden'. Here's the transcript of the video I recorded. Please build the SEO package for it.
evals.expected_output: A structured markdown SEO document saved as a .seo.md file. Titles, description, and tags center on the provided target keyword and the stated beginner gardening audience. Three titles, description with estimated chapters flagged as approximate, comma-separated tags under 500 characters, pinned comment, and thumbnail suggestions.
expectations: Output is a markdown document saved to a .seo.md file
Document has a Titles section with exactly three title options
The phrase 'beginner vegetable garden' appears in at least one title or in the description's first 150 characters
Document has a Description section containing chapter timestamps flagged as estimates
Document has a Tags section with comma-separated tags under 500 characters
Tags include gardening-specific phrases drawn from the transcript content
Document has a Pinned Comment section that invites a reply
Document has a Thumbnail Suggestions section with two or more suggestions
